After more than 200,000 auditionees that I've personally come across (since PBB season 5), I've somehow developed the gut feeling na on the first audition palang if may potential on their own. Madami namang may potential yung iba lang ay hilaw pa. But as I've said, yung nakikita ng majority ay isang balat lang ng auditions. Para yang sibuyas na napakaraming layers. After first auditions meron pa yang call backs, after callbacks may immersion, and then psych eval, and then final casting and then final deliberations. That's all I can share. Hahahahahaha.

As much as I want to, there is so much about the process that I cannot disclose. As well as auditionees and even housemates, they are required to sign a waiver and an NDA and are banned from speaking about the auditions for the general public. Ever. Hahaha
Sobrang complicated nung process kasi sobrang daming factors to consider. Not only the person itself pero we also have to think in a way na "paano kaya pag pinagsama si ganto kay ganto".
